name: opencode-plugin-cursor
description: OpenCode plugin for Cursor: Cursor models as an OpenCode provider (OpenCode v2 and 1.x), plus Cursor CLI and Cloud Agents tools

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist-test', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test --test-reporter=spec "dist-test/test/**/*.test.js"
